The instance handle is included if and only if the software compo- nent’s supportsMultipleInstantiation attribute is set to true. Note that Rte_Instance cannot be used directly, as there will be pointers to multiple components’ structure types within the single VFB Tracing header file, and Rte_Instance would therefore be ambigu- ous.
